audit_method: Every reachable repository was cloned and inspected. Components are listed with the evidence that they do or do not work. Nothing is inferred from a repository name.

components.name: Multi-tenant data layer
components.what_it_does: Rejects any statement touching a tenant-scoped table without a bound tenant predicate, before it reaches the database.
components.works_evidence: 10 tenant-isolation tests pass, including cross-tenant read attempts and audit-log immutability.

components.name: Authentication and RBAC
components.what_it_does: scrypt passwords, server-side sessions, lockout, CSRF, an enforced permission matrix and OIDC sign-in.
components.works_evidence: Verified live: unauthenticated GET / redirects to /login; READ_ONLY refused on all nine mutating routes.
components.notes: Mark's commercial gate is added as a 'commercial' permission.

components.name: Credential vault
components.what_it_does: AES-256-GCM per-tenant credential storage that refuses to store anything when no master key is configured.
components.works_evidence: 10 vault tests pass, including rotation and tamper detection.

components.name: Durable job queue
components.what_it_does: Atomic claim, retry with backoff, dead-letter, stale-lock recovery. Survives restart.
components.works_evidence: 8 queue tests pass; analysis verified running through it end to end against the live server.
components.notes: New job types for the GTM agents and autonomous recovery.

components.name: Company Digital Twin + provenance
components.what_it_does: 43 fields, each carrying value, source, method, confidence and timestamp; conflicting claims retained.
components.works_evidence: 9 evidence tests pass; three synthetic companies produce real understanding scores.
components.notes: Becomes the account intelligence record for GTM.

components.name: Website research connector
components.what_it_does: Crawls a homepage plus high-value internal pages, fingerprints technology, infers sector and segment, records provenance.
components.works_evidence: Fetches live sites; degrades to a low understanding score rather than inventing a business.
components.notes: This is the Market and Account Intelligence agents’ research capability.

components.name: Capability registry and router
components.what_it_does: Scores every registered capability action against a requested objective and explains the choice.
components.works_evidence: 16 router tests pass, including registering a new capability at runtime with no orchestration change.
components.notes: The ten GTM agents register here.

components.name: Benefits ledger
components.what_it_does: Six-stage forward-only value ratchet from theoretical to verified.
components.works_evidence: 8 ledger tests pass; verified value proven against a connected system in the verification suite.
components.notes: Pipeline value staging reuses this rather than inventing a parallel concept.

components.name: JoJo orchestrator
components.what_it_does: Parses an objective into a measurable outcome, selects work, reports shortfall honestly.
components.works_evidence: Answers the directive's own example objectives; reports an honest shortfall rather than inflating to hit a target.

components.name: Dual-provider email service
components.what_it_does: Selects SendGrid or AWS SES from environment variables and no-ops when neither is configured.
components.works_evidence: Code inspected and coherent; not executed here — different stack, no deployment reachable, no provider credentials.
components.notes: The provider-detection pattern is ported into the GTM outreach transport; the code is not imported across stacks.

components.name: SaleSonicAI
components.what_it_does: Declared: pipeline generation and sales execution. No implementation exists anywhere reachable.
components.works_evidence: No repository, no service endpoint, no credentials. Registered as a mock with 8 declared actions.
components.notes: The GTM outreach agent implements this function directly, behind the same interface, so a live SaleSonic can take over later.

components.name: Toleron
components.what_it_does: Declared: company, market and competitor analysis. No implementation exists anywhere reachable.
components.works_evidence: No repository, no service endpoint. Mocked.
components.notes: MetaMSP's own twin and website connector already perform this function with real provenance.

components.name: ListeningPost
components.what_it_does: Declared: external signal monitoring. The repository is empty.
components.notes: The GTM Signal Agent implements signal detection from the twin and public sources.

components.name: Onward systems (CRM, PSA, email, estate)
components.what_it_does: Onward’s own commercial systems. None is reachable: no endpoint, no dataset, no credentials.
components.works_evidence: No repository; no credentials present in this environment.
components.notes: A local CRM system of record is implemented behind a CRM adapter interface, so a real CRM connects later without changing the loop. See BLOCKERS.md.
